def get_closest_vowel(word):
    vowels = "aeiouAEIOU"
    n = len(word)
    
    # Start from the end of the word and look for consonants and vowels
    for i in range(n - 2, 0, -1):  # Start from the second last character to the second
        if word[i] in vowels:
            continue  # Skip vowels
        for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1):  # Look for a consonant before it
            if word[j] in vowels:
                break  # Stop if we find a vowel
            if j == 0:  # If we reached the start without finding a vowel
                return ""  # No valid vowel found
        if j >= 0 and word[j] in vowels:  # If we found a vowel
            return word[j]  # Return the vowel
    return ""  # If no valid vowel is found
